reference.title: Provide access to a customer account using the access request feature
reference.shortdesc: Direct access to a customer account can help resolve issues when screen shots and remote viewing sessions are not successful. By using the access request feature, the Red Hat support team collaborates with the customer who consents to the level of access and the duration of access.

section.p: In a typical situation, the customer opens a support case with the Red Hat support team. The Red Hat support team works with the customer to arrange access to the customer’s account and log in to their Red Hat Hybrid Cloud ConsoleRed Hat Hybrid Cloud Console.
Make sure to verify the following information before beginning any access request actions:

ul.li: The duration of the access which includes a maximum duration up to 12 months.
The default user access roles the customer wants granted to the Red Hat support team.

section.p: With the access request feature, system access is always controlled by the customer. The customer can deny access permissions at any time.
section.note: Any access request action is associated with the unique username of the Red Hat associate on the support team who made the request. This means each Red Hat access request is visible only to the Red Hat associate who made the request, and only that associate can access the customer system. If a different Red Hat support engineer is brought into the support case and needs access, a new access request action is required for that unique Red Hat username.
